'''Yraka Nes''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a medical [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]]. She lived among the [[Myyydril]] tribe within the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]].<ref name="Rage of the Wookiees" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yraka Nes appeared as a non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video game#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
